subject: Intro + demo for Catalyst Systems (introduced by Prime Integrations)
messages:
From: Maria Soto <maria@primeint.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Sean O'Neill <sean@catalystsys.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Introduction: Catalyst Systems (possible Redwood fit)

Hi Hannah —

Per our conversation earlier this week, I wanted to introduce you to Sean O'Neill at Catalyst Systems. They signed up for a trial and are evaluating options for serving high-throughput LLM inference for their search and summarization workflows. High level notes:
- Target: 50–200 req/s during peak for short-form summarization (avg 200 tokens)
- Concern: predictable latency and cost for production SLAs
- Interested in hosted + reserved options (mix might be useful)

Sean is cc'd. He mentioned Prime Integrations worked with Redwood previously on a POC so thought this was a good fit. Could you coordinate a 30–45 minute intro demo to walk through the platform and typical migration path? Sean's timezone is PST.

Attaching quick eval notes Prime compiled.

Attachment: catalyst-eval-notes.txt (partner notes)

Thanks —
Maria Soto
Partnerships, Prime Integrations
M: +1 415-555-0138

Subject: Re: Introduction: Catalyst Systems (possible Redwood fit)

Thanks Maria — great context and thanks for the intro.

Sean — welcome, and great to meet you. Short plan: 1) 30–45 minute demo to review platform fit and timing, 2) follow-up with a MAP (mutual action plan) and a capacity/price ballpark. Would this week or early next week work for you?

I can run the demo with Rafael (solutions lead). Dev will handle scheduling and the calendar invite.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Fri 16 Jan: 10:30–11:15 or 14:00–14:45
- Mon 19 Jan: 13:00–13:45 or 15:30–16:15

If none of those work, tell us 2–3 times that do and we’ll accommodate. I attached a short demo agenda so you know what we'll cover.

Attachment: demo-agenda.md

Best,

Quick note on attendees: I'd like to include our CTO, Priya Shah (cc'd here), and our platform lead if possible. We prefer afternoons PST next week. The Mon 19 Jan 15:30–16:15 slot could work for us, or Tue 20 Jan 14:00–14:45 if available.
